rows.TEXT: Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for his blood thirsts. It is said that he once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Known in her times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended her reign of terror. She is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to her will.
A veteran in the struggle to reclaim Elven glory, nobody enters the forest without his knowledge.

Serphis   
"Get the troops ready. I have just received word of the Oracle's arrival, but her escort is cornered and requires our assistance. We should find them if we follow the road south of our city."

Geintel 
"I shall join the search party. We must ensure her safety! If we lose our oracle, we lose our alliance!"

Serphis 
"Hmmm. I agree, but your willingness to participate surprises me, Geintel. I have no opposition, but I will send another group to...accompany...you."

Geintel	 
"Come now, if we delay for long the oracle is bound to come under attack! We cannot wait!"

Geintel

Geintel

Geintel 
"I see something approaching...a group of Elves...no...they are hunting us again!!!"

Geintel 
"NO! The oracle! We have lost the oracle..."

Geintel 
"What? This is a Dwarf! We must be too late! They must have taken her!"

Dwarf Engineer 
"Hold on to your arrows friends. I am not here as an enemy!"

Millu 
"Shield your weapons, this is Grizzlespit. He will be our key to defeating the Clans here!"

Geintel 
"We need no Dwarf plan to destroy them! This goes against the will of Gallean! How dare you..."

Millu 
"You are wrong. Gallean does not like this alliance, but he knows it is needed. He seeks something further, past the Clans. But please, let us reach safer ground for now, I shall explain then."

Geintel 
"Fine, but I will keep an eye on you Dwarf..."

Geintel 
"Just what we needed, the Demons have blocked our fastest route. We must find a way around them. We are still too weak to fight them."

Find a way to return Millu to the capital. 
 
Both Geintel and Millu must survive.

Grizzlespit 
"Now is not the time for such questions, Millu. We must get you back to the capital, let us move on."

"We have found several documents written in a Dwarf dialect unknown to us, I do not know if any one of us can read them. We shall keep them here until you find a means to read them."

Serphis 
"Thank Gallean, you have safely returned to us oracle. We had become quite worried after seeing Demons block the passage! Where is Geintel?"

Grizzlespit 
"We have lost him...trapped by dead Elves..."

Millu 
"...I should have known. I tried to speak with one of our fallen sisters. He thought I was trying to betray our people."

Grizzelspit 
"He tried to attack you Millu, he was irrational! You have no reason to blame yourself."

Millu 
"This is Grizzlespit. He has agreed to help us defeat the Clans and may have a plan to get us by them with little confrontation."

Grizzlespit 
"The Dwarves in this area follow Yatta'Halli, who leads her people towards peace at all cost and with a refusal of battle. Capture Yatta'Halli, offer them a peaceful way out and they will most likely agree to it."

Grizzlespit 
"I know the Clans have an ancient hideout, a place where they could go to when the Ragnarok came. It is not far from here. Yatta'Halli holds the key to open this place...or lock it."

Millu 
"With difficulty...but he knows we must follow this path...the Clans are not our true enemy...our destiny lies at the fortress of Temperance."

Serphis 
"Temperance? The very fortress where we forged an alliance with the Humans...and now we plan to break the alliance at that same location?"

Serphis 
"If this is what Gallean wishes, we shall follow Grizzlespit's plan. Geintel's remains will have to wait until we deal with the Clans."

Grizzlespit 
"Slow your step Leaf lic...Elf. Most towns in the area hold documents of value, but they are likely to be written in an ancient Dwarven dialect, a trick used to keep unwanted eyes from knowing what they hold!"

Grizzlespit 
"I can read these documents, you must allow me to visit the cities where they are being held and I will inform you of their content!"

Bring Grizzlespit to each city to decode Dwarven documents. 
 
 
Grizzlespit must survive.

Orc Champion 
"Why you come here!? We no join war, we NOT kill for you!"
"We do not come for your services Orc, we are taking this town! No Elf would stoop so low as to request help from your kind."

Orc Champion 
"CLOSE MOUTH!!! You all UGLY. AND STUPID too!  You ears floppy like rabbit! You weak and...er...SMELLY! Other Orc help and listen maybe. But WE NO LISTEN!"

Orc Champion 
"Greenskins remember this. One day, all you see is Greenskin! Everyone see revenge of Orcs. You wait!!!"

Grizzlespit 
"Hmmm, the documents stored here seem to be orders. See here? It mentions that both Wolfbanes were ready to support an upcoming offensive on some place named Luciors! Ahh...it says it's a Legion outpost!"

Grizzlespit 
"Sounds like the Clans are busy with the Demons. That explains why you have not received any letter from Yataa'Halli. Of course, the Legions are now but a bothersome thorn in our side."
Good day, Elves! We only have basic merchandise in stock these days, thanks to the Dwarves.

We are still under construction, but I do have a few spells that I am willing to sell.
"Humans...here? They seem to be on good terms with the Clans. No matter, we are taking this town - remove them."

Peasant

Town Peasant 
"If the seal keeping this item is any sign, it does have immense power. We have known of the location of one of these items, but never figured out the seal."
"I assume you wish to barter information for your life, is that it? Convince us that there is some great treasure to be plucked from these lands so we are distracted?"

Peasant 
"You have no reason to kill me; I have been honest with you! Visit an old ruined tower east of here, you will be convinced!"

Grizzlespit 
"This was a Human town. No Dwarven documents are to be found here! Let us move on!"

Greisle Crow 
"Hmm, quite skilled. This battle pleased me. I shall accept my death with honor."
"This one holds his tongue? I am rather surprised."

Greisle Crow

"This is a waste of time! Enough with the sweet talking Giant! End his life!"

We only have a few good items left, best pick em up while you can, Elves!

Grizzlespit

Grizzlespit 
"This is a cover. I know that Gheathrock never moves unless royalty moves. This means Yataa'Halli is in Kol too. But how do we get past the Gheathrock, right?"

Grizzlespit

My soldiers are the most formidable in the land.

Alchemist

"Bregrevein held meager defenses. It is obvious that the Clans have no real interest in this place. A foolish oversight they will learn to regret soon enough."

Alchemist 
"Oohhohaha!! Stop it! You believe that? Or are you just trying to reassure yourself? If you truly believe no one will notice you here, you must be senselessly brave or incredibly ignorant! Haha!"
"You seem to forget your Clan's famous past of missteps and ill decisions. But do not fret. You'll receive the same treatment as your brothers and sisters, Dwarf, even though you try to goad us."
Getting bested by the Dwarves? Well, ye now can use the very tools they trained with! For a price...

Grizzlespit 
"Nothing much here apart from this note about some shipment of iron ore and other materials. It was heading to a town near Temperance, for Gumtik Bledwater. A thief and a poor excuse for a Dwarf if I have ever seen one!"

Grizzlespit

Grizzlespit

Grizzlespit 
"What we need to do is intercept this scout, kill him, and then take his clothing. I will wear them, manage to get past their defenses, and enter Kol. The scout should come out again in four days. We will need to wait for him."

Grizzlespit
